'''Tan Yuster''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the decade marked by the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].

==Biography==
[[File:Ep2-ia-30408-cropped.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Agen Kolar kneels over Yuster's body.]]
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Tan Yuster was [[Jedi training/Legends|educated]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the decade marked by the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. Selected as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]], Tan constructed a green-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] which he wielded in battle. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Yuster accompanied his master to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] where he fought as part of a massive [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]] to liberate Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] from the Confederacy leaders. He did not survive the battle and during a lull in the fighting as the survivors regrouped at the arena's center gathering in a defensive circular formation Agen knelt down over his fallen Padawan to silently pay his respects.<ref name="db" />
